name: ubi-cms
description: UBI CMS monorepo — local stack helpers

scripts.local:rebuild: podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml build --no-cache && podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
scripts.local:rebuild:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml build --no-cache && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
scripts.dev:rebuild: podman compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && podman compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev:rebuild:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
